name: R046-scary-face-vs-speed-boost
why: Challenge number 2 (AI_CheckBadMove). The opponent's Mightyena (set 307) knows Scary Face; the player's Ninjask (set 343) has Speed Boost as its only ability, so the AI's guess of the target's ability is Speed Boost. On turn 1 AI_CBM_SpeedDown gives Scary Face -10.
